messages:
jules_support: FYI, AcmeCorp invoice INV-2024-311 failed to pay — card declined. Customer says they require a PO and want Net 45 rather than upfront. attaching context below.

billing_bot: Payment attempt failed for INV-2024-311: authorization declined (card on file ending 4242). Retry scheduled in 24h.

mike_sales: Pushed by Acme's procurement — they will only pay via PO (PO# ACME-PO-789) and need Net 45 terms. Sales asked to escalate; they're a midmarket account with $45k annual commit.

sara_cs: Customer reached out complaining about app access loss because we suspended on non-payment. They attached signed SOW and PO PDF. They explicitly said "we cannot do upfront invoice — must be arrears on Net 45 per corporate policy."

jules_support: Can we avoid suspending access while legal/finance approve? They are in active rollout, suspending hurts adoption.

ivan_finance: Need to run credit check and confirm vat/tax handling before approving Net 45. Also we require PO on file for arrears billing — that's ok if PO is valid. Sending checklist.

beth_legal: Note — PO references EU entity and reverse-charge VAT. We need the signed reseller/contract entity match to legal name on PO. If mismatch, we need corrected PO or tax paperwork.

oliver_billing: I can take manual collection. Quick questions: 1) Is PO PDF attached to this thread? 2) Which billing entity should invoice (Redwood Inc vs Redwood EU)?

mike_sales: PO attached in email thread (linked). Use Redwood EU entity for invoice and mark VAT as reverse-charge; Acme procurement confirmed.

ivan_finance: Credit check in progress. If credit OK, finance can approve Net 45 for this account as a one-off but need approver on record. Also need a signed payment schedule or payment plan in Zendesk.

jules_support: Customer asks we re-enable service immediately once PO received — can we do conditional access pending finance approval?

oliver_billing: Proposed workaround: accept PO and issue invoice with Net 45 but set "service on hold" flag to off for 7 days while finance confirms. We need explicit written confirmation from Acme that PO authorizes access.

sara_cs: I'll get the signed email confirmation from Acme legal and paste here.

beth_legal: Also flag: If VAT reverse-charge applies, customer must provide VAT ID. Request that in the same email.

billing_bot: Manual invoice created: INV-2024-311-M1 (pending). Amount: $45,000. Due: Net 45 if approved. Link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2024-311-M1

mike_sales: Sales requests expedited approval — this is a reference customer. Can finance waive the standard 60-day credit review and approve Net 45 as exception?

ivan_finance: We can approve as exception once credit check passes and PO + VAT ID + signed confirmation are attached. I'll log the exception and route to CFO for sign-off (ETA 24–48h).

jules_support: Action items: Sara to upload signed confirmation + VAT ID, Oliver to hold off suspension and create manual invoice draft, Ivan to run credit check and submit exception form, Beth to validate PO legal entity.

sara_cs: uploaded email from Acme legal with PO and VAT number (VAT: GB999999973). Confirmed entity: Acme Ltd.

ivan_finance: Received docs. Credit OK (soft check). Routing to CFO for exception. If CFO approves, we'll convert manual invoice to live and set terms Net 45.

oliver_billing: Once I get CFO clearance I will send the invoice to Acme procurement and mark account active. Please copy me on the procurement confirmation email.

beth_legal: PO entity matches contract. VAT reverse-charge accepted for EU entity. No further legal blocks.

billing_bot: Exception logged: EXC-2024-88 assigned to ivan_finance. Status: pending CFO approval.

ivan_finance: CFO approved exception at 1745004000. Converted INV-2024-311-M1 -> INV-2024-311. Terms: Net 45. Manual charge attempt cancelled. Oliver, send invoice to procurement and update billing notes.

oliver_billing: Invoice sent to procurement (sent at 1745004123). Account unsuspended at 1745004200. Noted Net 45.

jules_support: Thanks team — customer confirms restored access and approved PO linked to invoice. Closing escalation once we see payment. :thumbsup:

mike_sales: Good job — keep me posted if payment misses Net 45 so we can work collections.

billing_bot: Reminder scheduled: Payment reminder for INV-2024-311 at 1745008123 (5 days before due).

sara_cs: noted, monitoring."
